task: Implement a reusable 'Featured benefits' Shopify Online Store 2.0 section (icon + heading + text, repeatable). It must follow OS 2.0 best practice: merchant-editable via the theme customizer with blocks, schema with sensible settings + presets, accessible, performant, and theme-native CSS — NOT over-engineered. Return the section Liquid + schema.
reference: Excellent = a proper OS 2.0 section: repeatable {% for block in section.blocks %} with {{ block.shanboly... }} settings (icon, heading, richtext), a valid {% schema %} with block type + settings + a {% schema %} preset so it's insertable in the customizer, semantic/accessible markup (heading levels, alt/aria, img width+height + loading=lazy), theme-native CSS scoped to the section (one CSS system — no Tailwind, no inline mega-styles), and block.shopify_attributes on the block wrapper. Bad = hardcoded content with no blocks/schema (not merchant-editable), no preset, inline non-reusable markup, missing accessibility/perf, or pulls in Tailwind/extra frameworks (over-engineering, anti-pattern Rule 9).
